budget.covers: Your {{budget}} budget covers the expected cost ({{low}} to {{high}}).
budget.mayExceed: The expected cost ({{low}} to {{high}}) may go over your {{budget}} budget. Runs stop when the budget is used up.
budget.unknown: Price unknown: no past runs of this setup here. You will never spend more than {{budget}}.
budget.noBudget: No budget set: each benchmark may spend up to {{cap}}.
budget.belowOneRun: This budget is less than one run costs (about {{run}} per run), so no run would start. Set at least {{min}}.
budget.unknownRunCost: The cost of a run is not known yet, so the budget is split evenly across the runs. A run can cost more than its share, so the total can pass the budget a little before it stops.

summary.mcpGateway: MCP tool calls go through Bifrost's MCP gateway.
summary.mcpCodeMode: MCP tool calls go through Bifrost's MCP gateway, with Code Mode.
summary.cache: Also runs a second setup with Bifrost's cache on.
summary.failover: Also runs a second setup with Bifrost fallbacks ({{models}}) while the main model is down.
summary.gate: Checks the release rules when it finishes.
summary.tasks: Use {{n}} tasks from each benchmark and try each task {{trials}}.
summary.tasksReady: Use up to {{n}} tasks from each benchmark ({{ready}} ready in all) and try each task {{trials}}.
summary.clean: Run clean only, with no faults.
summary.defaultBudget: Stop each benchmark when its spending reaches {{usd}} (the default budget).

basis.library: Estimated from other agents' runs of these benchmarks. Your own runs will make it more exact.
basis.own: Estimated from past runs of this agent and model.
basis.rough: Rough estimate from list prices: this setup has no past runs here yet.

slots.overWorker: Your worker runs {{n}} runs at a time, so {{value}} runs at once is no faster than {{n}}.

launch.budgetNotNumber: Enter an amount in dollars, for example 5.
launch.budgetNotPositive: Enter an amount above $0, or leave the box empty for the default of ${{cap}} per benchmark.
launch.budgetTooHigh: The most one evaluation can spend is ${{max}}.
launch.budgetAboveSuggested: This is above the suggested maximum of {{max}} for your organization.
launch.budgetBelowFloor: The budget must be at least $0.01 per benchmark: at least {{min}} for {{count}}.
launch.suggestedWhy: Suggested: covers the expected cost of {{runs}} runs. You can lower it; the evaluation stops when it is reached.
launch.useDefaultCap: Use the default cap instead ({{cap}} per benchmark, {{total}} in all)
launch.budgetSplit: Split evenly over the benchmarks; each one stops starting runs when its share is spent.
launch.budgetEmpty: Empty means the default: each benchmark stops at {{cap}}.

own.noLetters: Use letters or digits in the name.
own.builtinTaken: {{id}} is a built-in benchmark. Pick another name.
own.orgTaken: Your organization already has a benchmark called {{id}}. Pick another name, for example {{suggest}}.

pack.some: {{benchmarks}}, {{runnable}} your agent can run · {{tasks}} it can run

power.line: These settings can detect a change of about {{n}} points overall{{per}}.
power.perTooFew: (too few tasks to decide per benchmark)
power.tooFew: These settings have too few tasks to detect a change.
power.tooFewChange: Too few tasks to see any change.

note.sameConfig: Pick a second model to see the price.
